newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.

text.p: Prices ended mixed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Friday, while volume picked up due to lower prices in the morning and free market demand ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Gold closed at $380.50 an ounce, down from $382 on Wednesday when the last dollar term trade took place.
Gold fell to 1,159,700 lira per gram at midday from Thursday's 1,162,250 close in line with the world trends, but jumped to 1,165,200 at the close on a weaker lira.
The lira ended at 94,900 per dollar against Thursday's 94,670 after the central bank raised sharply its key dollar rate for banks' compulsory currency transfers to prop up the U.S. currency.
"Demand increased in the morning on cheaper world prices. There was also buying ahead of the weekend," said one dealer.
Traded volume rose to 966 kilos from Thursday's 803, with 68 percent in lira terms.
